goal: Wire the already-implemented Fixed-group convergence, pre_mutation_checks divergence/napi-drift detection, and cross-group conflict detection into callisto-graph's real cascade and version-command call paths, per SPEC-TRACK1-FIXED-GROUP-CASCADE-CORRECTNESS.
architecture: Four independent-but-sequenced slices: (1) add a `tags: &TagIndex` field to CascadeInput and update all 15 real/test construction sites so the crate compiles; (2) add a new Fixed-group convergence block to solve_cascade's fixpoint loop, structurally mirroring the existing Linked-group block, which depends on the tags field; (3) wire crate::groups::pre_mutation_checks into plan_version's real orchestration path (NapiTargetsIndex construction, six-argument call, diagnostics merge, error propagation) before run_cascade; (4) add cross-group conflict detection to GroupTable::resolve via a single combined claimed-PackageId map shared across the fixed and linked resolution loops. Slice 1 must land in full before slices 2 and 3 compile; slice 4 is independent and can run in any order. Correction: slice 4's own logic (config/groups.rs's GroupTable::resolve) is independent of slices 1-3's logic, but its test binary shares the callisto-graph lib compilation target, so T10 must still be sequenced after T04 (which closes out slice 1's full-crate compile) before its test can build and run -- otherwise its RED step fails with unrelated missing-field compile errors from cascade.rs/version.rs/snapshot.rs rather than the intended assertion failure.
reasoning: Read cascade.rs, config/groups.rs, groups.rs, napi.rs, tags.rs, commands/version.rs, commands/snapshot.rs, error.rs, identity.rs, and both existing test files (cascade_tests.rs, config_resolve_tests.rs) live from disk before writing any task, confirming every line number, signature, and existing test-helper pattern the spec's api_surface cites (all matched). Key groundings: (a) TagIndex has no test-friendly constructor besides build()/empty(), so real-tags fixtures reuse the exact FakeGitTagRunner + non_repo_dir + crate::config::load pattern already proven in tags.rs's own test module, giving cascade.rs's new test a real TagIndex with last_tag(A)=Some/last_tag(B)=None without touching TagIndex's private fields. (b) GroupTable::resolve is exercised through real Workspace::load with hand-written callisto.toml fixtures (mirroring the pre-existing config_resolve_tests.rs pattern) rather than synthetic direct map construction, satisfying AC-013's bug-3 clause. (c) AC-002/AC-004's 'real call path, not fixed_group_target called directly, not raise()-triggered' requirement is satisfied by a single test that constructs CascadeInput with both siblings in seed (never touching raise()) and calls run_cascade directly, asserting on CascadeOutcome.targets -- this one test satisfies AC-001, AC-002, AC-004, and AC-013's bug-1 clause simultaneously. (d) plan_version's pre_mutation_checks wiring is tested exclusively through plan_version itself (never calling pre_mutation_checks directly), satisfying AC-013's bug-2 clause; NapiTargetsIndex::load's own ManifestError::Parse path is reached transparently through plan_version's `?` propagation via GraphError's #[from] ManifestError conversion, so AC-007b needs no new error-conversion code, only a fixture. (e) Because CascadeInput's struct addition breaks compilation crate-wide (cascade.rs's own test module lives in the same lib target as commands/version.rs and commands/snapshot.rs), tasks 1-3 in slice 1 cannot each independently reach a fully green `cargo test -p callisto-graph --no-run`; their RED/GREEN check is scoped to that file's own missing-field errors via grep, with task 4 (snapshot.rs) as the slice's closing task confirming full-crate green and covering AC-003. (f) GroupTable::resolve's cross-group check uses a single BTreeMap<PackageId, GroupName> populated across both the fixed and linked resolution loops, checked before each insert; re-inserting the same PackageId under the same group name is a no-op (preserves the explicit non-goal that within-group duplicate spellings are not deduplicated), while a different group name triggers GraphError::ConflictingGroupMembership -- this satisfies both AC-010 (fixed/fixed) and AC-010b (fixed/linked) with one code path.

tasks.title: Add tags field to CascadeInput and update cascade.rs's own 7 test literals
steps: RED: run `cargo check -p callisto-graph --lib --message-format=short 2>&1 | grep 'cascade.rs'`. At this point CascadeInput has no `tags` field yet, so this command produces no missing-field errors (nothing to grep) -- this is the baseline. Add ONLY the struct field declared below (do not touch the 7 test literals yet), save, and re-run the same grep command. Expected output: 7 lines of the form `crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs:NNN:9: error[E0063]: missing field \`tags\` in initializer of \`CascadeInput<'_, _>\`` at lines 698, 779, 850, 947, 1074, 1157, 1237 (their line numbers will shift slightly once the field is added earlier in the file; match by content, not exact number).
Add `use crate::tags::TagIndex;` to cascade.rs's top-level `use` block (alongside the existing `use crate::config::GroupTable;` line).
In the `CascadeInput` struct definition, add a new field after `pub pre: Option<&'a callisto_format::PreState>,`: `pub tags: &'a TagIndex,`.

In each of the 7 pre-existing `CascadeInput { ... }` literals inside cascade.rs's `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` block (the ones ending `base: &base, pre: None,` or `pre: Some(&pre),`), add a new line `tags: &TagIndex::empty(),` immediately after the `pre: ...,` line. None of these 7 construct a Fixed group (they use Linked groups, GroupTable::default(), or no groups), so `TagIndex::empty()` is correct for all of them.

GREEN: run `cargo check -p callisto-graph --lib --message-format=short 2>&1 | grep 'cascade.rs'`. Expected output: empty (no lines) -- every missing-field error attributable to cascade.rs itself is gone. The overall `cargo check` command will still exit non-zero at this point because commands/version.rs, commands/snapshot.rs, and tests/cascade_tests.rs have not been updated yet (that is expected and resolved by T02-T04).
